note: Every source a registry rule, a worked example or a lexicon entry may quote. A source enters only with a recorded licence that allows commercial use (vignette-proof.js licenceAllows rejects anything else, StatPearls always). The snapshot is the text the quotes are proven against, pinned by its SHA-256; tools/criteria/fetch-sources.mjs fetches the live source and reports any change.
